messages:
deploy-bot: rollout r-2026-03-15-11:02 started: model phoenix-v2.12 -> gpu-highmem pool (canary 10%).
incident-bot: :rotating_light: GPU pool high utilization alert: gpu-highmem utilization > 92% AND queue length > 500 for 2m -- paging oncall.
maria (oncall): acked. looking now. grabbing metrics.
aj: oncall handoff noted, i'm free to help — where are the dashboards?
maria (oncall): grafana link: https://grafana/redwood/d/gpu-pools — queue spike at 11:04. Canary traffic looks OK initially then huge prefill burst.
sam: observed clients doing a prefill path; new phoenix-v2.12 prefill sends full-context warmup for many requests (prewarm_tokens=4096) — KV cache growth per session x3.
ops-bot: current queue length: 1762 requests. avg latency 1.8s -> 12s. p95 tokens/sec dropped.
maria (oncall): autoscaler logs show scale_up attempts but rejected: "capacity limit reached for pool gpu-highmem (limit=24)".
aj: hmm we set a conservative pool cap earlier this quarter due to infra budget. can we temporarily lift to 36?
maria (oncall): trying increase, running infra-cli pool update --name gpu-highmem --cap 36
ops-bot: pool update API returning 403: requires approvals for >30.
maria (oncall): approval required, can't wait. manual mitigations: 1) reduce canary traffic 2) disable phoenix-v2.12 prefill behavior (toggle on model config) 3) enable fallback to phoenix-v2.11.
sam: I can patch the model config to disable prefill warmup now. applying patch: \n```
model-config phoenix-v2.12 {
  prefill_enabled: false
}
```
ops-bot: patch applied to canary nodes.
incident-bot: Config change detected for model phoenix-v2.12 by sam at 11:09.
jessica (cs): Customer A on enterprise tier reporting intermittent 503s and slow completions since ~11:05. Raising severity.
maria (oncall): noted. immediate mitigation: shift 90% traffic off phoenix-v2.12 back to v2.11. executing traffic-split rollback.
ops-bot: traffic-split update in progress... 90% -> phoenix-v2.11.
kevin (pm): please also post a short customer note, CS can send an update once we confirm service stabilizes.
ops-bot: queue length dropping: 1762 -> 420 after traffic rollback and prefill toggle. GPUs freeing KV memory; pool utilization down to 48% in 6m.
aj: autoscaler now able to request scale_up to 28 but still waiting for approval to 36. unnecessary for now since queue falling.
maria (oncall): confirm rollback complete, canary aborted. root cause hypothesis: phoenix-v2.12 introduced a default prefill token/kv warmup that multiplies KV memory by ~3x for typical requests — caused pool exhaustion under live traffic.
devex: note for release: prefill flag should be opt-in behind feature-flag + load test with kv warmup profile.
jessica (cs): Customer A update drafted: "We're rolling back a recent model update that caused increased latency for a subset of requests. No data loss; services restored." Want me to send?
kevin (pm): send once stable and queue < 100 and no more 5xx spikes.
ops-bot: last_message_ts check: 11:22. queue length 68, p95 latency back to 0.9s.
maria (oncall): marking incident as mitigated. will keep thread open for postmortem notes.
aj: quick follow-ups: - find the telemetry test that would have caught warmup kv growth - add pre-deploy stress test against pool cap - change pool cap approvers or automate short-term emergency elevation.
sam: i'll open an RFC outlining the prefill change and the canary validation steps. linking in thread after this.
kevin (pm): estimate customer impact: Customer A saw ~6 minutes of errors, about 3% of enterprise requests affected. we'll include in postmortem.
jessica (cs): I'll notify the customer once you post final postmortem (cc billing/ops).
maria (oncall): creating incident-tkt-9876 for follow-ups and assigning owners.
incident-bot: Incident mitigated by oncall at 11:22. Postmortem requested.
ops-bot: summary metrics snapshot attached: cpu/gpu mem, queue length timeline, autoscaler events (scale_up attempts x4, rejections x3), model config diff.
maria (oncall): thanks everyone. big win on quick rollback. rough timeline will go into ticket.
kevin (pm): add to next weekly all-hands: rollout safety checklist.
devex: note — update quickstart and example to mention prefill knobs.
aj: leaving oncall now, handoff to sam for follow-ups. :thumbsup:
